conflictPairs.label: Source ambiguity 1
conflictPairs.source_text: The main Methods report injection of 4 mL 2 M TOP-Se; SI p.1 instead prepares 2 mL 2 M TOP-Se plus 2 mL TBP and calls the final feed 1 M Se. These are conflicting descriptions of the source core method, not independently established experimental batches. Neither is silently selected or corrected.
conflictPairs.resolution: Source wording or condition remains unresolved; no silent correction.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
